label.description: Only open issues with this label become tasks. Set at most one of label and milestone; with neither, every open issue of tracker.repo becomes a task.

milestone.description: Only open issues in the milestone with this title become tasks. Set at most one of label and milestone; with neither, every open issue of tracker.repo becomes a task.

reposWithoutCi.description: Repos from repos that run no CI checks, in any letter case. In a listed repo, a PR whose check list on head is empty passes the Dev gate check condition instead of waiting in Dev. A list of only skipped checks still waits, and red or pending checks still count. A listed repo whose branch protection requires checks that have not reported yet also passes, so list only repos that run no checks. Without this key, a PR with no checks waits in Dev.

link.description: How a project links a PR to its task. A github-issues project reads an issue number from PRs in tracker.repo; a Jira project reads an issue key with one of tracker.projectKeys from PRs in repos. Left at the defaults, a Jira project links every tracker.projectKeys key (such as PROJ-12, any letter case) in the PR title or head branch. Set the sources and patterns to the branch and PR title naming rules of the repos. The board does not enforce those rules; the repo enforces them through its CI title check and its agents' skills. board doctor compares these rules with recent PRs by operatorGithubLogin.

sources.description: Where a PR names its task, in priority order; the first source that yields an issue number wins (for a Jira project, an issue key). closing: issues in tracker.repo the PR closes (Closes #12 in the body, or linked in the sidebar), for PRs to the default branch only; a Jira project skips it. branch: branchPattern on the head branch. title: titlePattern on the PR title.

branchPattern.description: Regular expression that starts with ^ and whose one capture group reads the issue number from a PR head branch, such as <agent>-<number>-<slug>. Branches longer than 255 characters are not matched. For a Jira project the capture group reads the issue key, such as PROJ-12, which must use one of tracker.projectKeys in any letter case; left at the default, a Jira project finds every such key in the PR head branch.

titlePattern.description: Regular expression that starts with ^ and whose one capture group reads the issue number from a PR title, such as fix(core): #12 summary. Titles longer than 255 characters are not matched. For a Jira project the capture group reads the issue key, such as PROJ-12, which must use one of tracker.projectKeys in any letter case; left at the default, a Jira project finds every such key in the PR title.

operatorGithubLogin.description: The GitHub account agents open PRs under. PR discovery in repos keeps only PRs whose author is this login. It is not necessarily the maintainer's own account: when agents push as one account and a maintainer approves as another, set the agents' account, or no PR is discovered.

name.description: The name of the project in Spur. A Spur project can be listed under only one board project.

role.description: worker: sessions of this Spur project may link to this project's tasks through their PR or branch. operator: sessions act as the operator. curator: sessions answer the questions no column orchestrator takes and escalate the rest to the operator; a board project has at most one.

cycleLimit.description: How many times a task may return to Dev from this column before the board stops it for the operator. Returns by the column executor, changes requested and external comments count; a conflict, red CI and a draft do not.

blockOpenMs.description: How long a block may stay open before an item is raised in milliseconds.

firstRetryMs.description: Wait after the first unanswered doorbell in milliseconds.

secondRetryMs.description: Wait after the second unanswered doorbell in milliseconds.

unansweredAfterMs.description: Wait after the third unanswered doorbell in milliseconds.

port.description: Local HTTP API port (0 assigns a free port). The default 4777 is above 4310-4399, a margin kept for Spur's server port 4310 and the ports from 4311 upward that its MCP port takes, and avoids Spur's ports 5555 and 8730-8799 and the Linux ephemeral range 32768-60999.

intervalMs.description: Time between two polls in milliseconds.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the local Spur HTTP API.

intervalMs.description: Time between two polls in milliseconds.
Time between two polls in milliseconds.

authRetryMs.description: Wait before polling a source again after an auth error in milliseconds.

goneAfterPolls.description: Complete polls an entity must be missing from before it counts as gone.

reserveRemaining.description: GitHub API requests to leave unused in each quota window.

errorAfterMs.description: How long a session stays in error before it is flagged in milliseconds.

needsInputAfterMs.description: How long a session waits for input before it is flagged in milliseconds.

idleInDevAfterMs.description: How long a worker session without an open PR, or the executor of a taken turn, waits at its prompt before it is flagged in milliseconds.

flipSmoothingMs.description: How long a new session health value must hold before it is reported in milliseconds.

sessions.description: Sessions entering error within the window that start an episode.

windowMs.description: Window in which that many sessions entering error start a host-load episode in milliseconds.

maxEpisodeMs.description: Longest a host-load episode lasts before error flags resume in milliseconds.
